title: Park Group expands north India footprint with 330-bed hospital in Uttarakhand
summary: With the addition of the new hospital, the group has expanded its operational presence to six states across north India, strengthening its hospital network and increasing its bed capacity in an underserved region.

New Delhi: Park Group of Hospitals on Sunday announced its entry into Uttarakhand with the launch of The Medicity Hospital, Rudrapur, a 330-bed multi-super speciality facility that it said is the largest hospital in the Kumaon region.With the addition of the new hospital, the group has expanded its operational presence to six states across north India, strengthening its hospital network and increasing its bed capacity in an underserved region.

According to the company, the facility is equipped with advanced multi-disciplinary clinical capabilities, modern medical infrastructure and a specialist team drawn from premier medical institutions.

Advt

It aims to cater to the growing demand for tertiary and quaternary healthcare services in the Kumaon region while supporting the group's long-term expansion plans.

The company said the expansion is in line with its strategy of building an integrated multi-state hospital network with stronger regional presence, referral synergies and sustainable long-term growth.Commenting on the launch, Dr Ankit Gupta, Managing Director, Park Medi World Limited, said that the launch of 'The Medicity Hospital', Rudrapur represents a milestone in Park Hospital's aggressive expansion strategy, further cementing their position as the dominant multi-super speciality healthcare platform across north India.

"With this addition, we have successfully established 'The Medicity Hospital' as the definitive comprehensive healthcare destination for the entire Kumaon region - a large, underpenetrated market with significant untapped demand," he said.This launch directly addresses the accelerating demand for specialised tertiary and quaternary care in the region, positioning the facility for robust growth in both case volumes and case complexity - key drivers of long-term revenue and margin expansion.
